title: Power of Four
description:
Given an integer n, determine whether it is a power of four.

Return true if there exists an integer x such that:

n = 4^x

Otherwise, return false.
input_format: The input contains a single integer.
constraints:
-2³¹ ≤ n ≤ 2³¹ - 1
Follow-up
Can you solve this problem without using loops or recursion?
